# Weather

> A free, open-source Android weather app that shows current conditions, a
> 24-hour outlook and a 7-day forecast for any location — found by search or by
> device GPS. Kotlin and Jetpack Compose, no API key, no account, no tracking.
> Ported from a Samsung Tizen TV app that showed one hardcoded city.

Built by Babak Bandpey (Cocode, https://cocode.dk). Apache-2.0.

Two design rules govern most of the code and are the usual source of confusion:

- **Wall-clock times are parsed as digits, never as instants.** Open-Meteo returns
  local time strings already in the requested location's timezone. Routing them
  through `Instant`/`Date` would re-interpret them in the phone's zone and shift
  every forecast for a city the user does not live in. `Units.parseLocal` reads
  the digits directly; `PlaceHeader` derives the location's clock from the API's
  `utc_offset_seconds`.
- **Missing data renders as `--`, never as a number.** `org.json` returns `NaN`
  and `0` where the API means "no value", so `data/Json.kt` collapses those to
  Kotlin `null` before any formatter sees them.

- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/cocodedk/weather-android/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): architecture, layer rules, conventions, and what carried over from the Tizen app
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/cocodedk/weather-android/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): local setup, hooks, branch naming, PR checklist
- [SECURITY](https://github.com/cocodedk/weather-android/blob/main/SECURITY.md): reporting policy and the app's (small) attack surface

## Source

- [domain/](https://github.com/cocodedk/weather-android/tree/main/app/src/main/java/dk/cocode/weather/domain): pure Kotlin — WMO codes, unit conversion, wall-clock parsing. No Android imports.
- [data/](https://github.com/cocodedk/weather-android/tree/main/app/src/main/java/dk/cocode/weather/data): Open-Meteo forecast and geocoding clients, device location, DataStore persistence, per-place response cache
- [ui/](https://github.com/cocodedk/weather-android/tree/main/app/src/main/java/dk/cocode/weather/ui): Compose screen, ViewModel, and the weather icon set drawn to a Canvas
- [website/](https://github.com/cocodedk/weather-android/tree/main/website): the GitHub Pages site — plain HTML/CSS/JS, no build step, with a live Open-Meteo widget

## Related

- [Copenhagen Weather (Tizen TV)](https://github.com/cocodedk/copenhagen-weather-tv): the app this was ported from
- [Open-Meteo](https://open-meteo.com): the forecast and geocoding API, free and key-less
